weapon.special_feature: The Wave Cutter is a ceremonial paddle carved from a single piece of ancient koa wood, its surface smooth and warm from centuries of use. The blade is shaped like a stylized wave, curving elegantly, and is inlaid with mother-of-pearl patterns of fish and sea birds. The handle is wrapped in braided sennit, worn smooth by countless hands. In Balthuikan's hands, the paddle can cut through any water, calm any storm, and guide any vessel to safety. A single stroke can part rough seas, create a path through turbulent waters, or propel a boat with supernatural speed.
special_skills: Calm Waters (stills rough seas and storms)
Path Cut (creates a path through any water)
Speed Stroke (propels a vessel with supernatural speed)
Safe Harbor (guides a vessel to safety)

basic_skills.name: Current Pull
basic_skills.description: Balthuikan gestures with the Wave Cutter, and a gentle current forms in the air or water, pulling allies toward safety or enemies away from their targets.

basic_skills.name: Star Glimpse
basic_skills.description: He holds up the Star Compass and peers into it. For a moment, he can see the immediate future of a target, revealing their next move or the danger they are about to face.

basic_skills.name: Wave Step
basic_skills.description: He touches the Wave Cutter to the ground, and a wave of shimmering energy flows beneath his feet, carrying him rapidly across any surface as if surfing.

passive_skill.name: Eternal Current
passive_skill.description: Balthuikan is perpetually aware of the flow of events, of journeys, of lives. He can sense when someone is lost, when a voyage is in danger, when a traveler needs guidance. This connection to the great current of existence makes him an unparalleled guide and protector of all who journey.

special_skills.name: Star Path
special_skills.description: Balthuikan raises the Star Compass, and above him, the stars themselves seem to brighten and shift, forming a glowing path across the sky that leads to the desired destination. All who follow the path are guided safely, finding their way through any obstacle.

special_skills.name: Tidal Wave
special_skills.description: He sweeps the Wave Cutter in a wide arc, and a massive wave of shimmering, turquoise energy erupts, washing over the battlefield. The wave does not harm allies; it carries them to safety, repositioning them where they need to be. Enemies are swept away, not harmed, but displaced and disoriented.

special_skills.name: Safe Harbor
special_skills.description: Balthuikan plants the Wave Cutter in the ground and spreads his arms. A dome of calm, shimmering water forms around himself and his allies, a safe harbor in the midst of chaos. Within the dome, they are protected from all harm, and they can rest, heal, and plan.

ultimate_skill.name: Shimmering Scale's Judgment: The Eternal Voyage
ultimate_skill.description: Balthuikan's turquoise eyes blaze with the light of a thousand stars reflected on a thousand oceans, and he raises both the Star Compass and the Wave Cutter high above his head. The Star Compass spins, its gem-stars flaring with brilliant light, projecting a massive star chart across the sky. The Wave Cutter sweeps down, and a great wave rises, not of water, but of pure, shimmering energy. He speaks a single word: 'Hōkūle'a,' the guiding star. And then the voyage begins. All allies are lifted onto the wave, carried forward at impossible speed, guided by the star chart above. They are taken exactly where they need to be, through any obstacle, past any danger. Enemies are left behind, stranded, as the wave carries the worthy forward on their journey. And at the head of the wave, Balthuikan stands, his cape of scales rippling, his hair flowing, guiding them all. When the wave finally subsides, allies find themselves exactly where they needed to be, their journey complete, their purpose fulfilled. Balthuikan stands among them, his eyes slowly dimming, a serene smile on his lips. He has guided them home. He is the Shimmering Scale, and the eternal voyage continues.

title: The Silver Crescent, The Night's Guardian
lore: When the breath of creation shaped the Luminals, Arguina emerged as the eighth, a being of quiet vigilance and gentle darkness. She was named the Silver Crescent, for she was born from the first night, the first shadow that gave meaning to light. Her purpose was the observation of rest, of dreams, of the vulnerable hours when the world sleeps. She watched the first mothers tuck their children into beds of leaves, the first guards keep watch over sleeping villages, the first dreamers journey through realms of imagination. She saw the peace of sleeping cities, the terror of nightmares, the quiet courage of those who stand guard while others rest. For eons, she watched, her heart stirred by the vulnerability of sleepers, the devotion of guardians, the mystery of dreams. But she remained detached, an observer of nights, not a participant in their darkness. But even the Silver Crescent could not remain forever unmoved. She watched a young girl in ancient Mongolia, a girl named Altansarnai, who was born with the gift of prophetic dreams. Her people revered her, but her gift was also a curse, for she saw not only the future but also the nightmares of others, and they haunted her waking hours. She could not sleep without seeing the fears of her tribe. Arguina watched her for years, feeling something stir within her celestial heart—not just appreciation, but a fierce, protective tenderness. When a terrible nightmare threatened to consume Altansarnai's mind, a vision of her people's destruction so vivid that she could not wake, Arguina reached out and gently soothed her, whispering peace into her dreams, replacing the nightmare with a vision of hope. Altansarnai woke calm and shared the hopeful vision with her people, preparing them for a danger they then avoided. And Arguina felt a warmth unlike any she had known. She had interfered. She had broken her code. But as she watched Altansarnai live a long life, using her gift to help her people, she knew she could not regret it. Now, she watches all who sleep, all who dream, all who guard the night. She cannot intervene often, but sometimes, in moments of crisis, a nightmare becomes a dream, a restless sleeper finds peace, a guard finds the strength to stay awake. That is Arguina, the Silver Crescent, reminding them that the night is not empty, that someone watches while they rest.
description: Arguina is the embodiment of quiet vigilance and lunar grace, a being who seems to glow with the soft, silver light of a full moon. She stands at a graceful five feet seven inches, her form slender and elegant, built not for battle but for the silent, patient watch of the night. Every line of her body speaks of stillness and awareness, like a deer poised at the edge of a moonlit clearing. Her skin is the color of pale, luminous silver, with a soft, ethereal glow that seems to emanate from within, like moonlight reflecting off fresh snow. It is smooth and cool to the touch, with a faint, shimmering quality, as if dusted with silver stardust. Her face is a study in Central Asian beauty—refined, elegant, with high, sweeping cheekbones, a straight, delicate nose, and a soft, rounded chin. Her lips are full and set in a serene, gentle smile, the expression of one who watches over sleepers with infinite tenderness. But her eyes are her most captivating feature: they are large, almond-shaped, and the color of deep, luminous silver, like twin moons reflected in a still lake. They hold an eternal, patient vigilance, and within their depths, one can glimpse the flicker of a million peaceful nights, a million dreams dreamt, a million sleepers protected. They are calm, but watchful, like the eyes of a guardian who never sleeps. Her hair is a magnificent feature—a long, flowing cascade of deep, midnight blue, so dark it is almost black, with streaks of luminous silver that shimmer like moonlight on water. It falls past her waist in soft, straight waves, and woven through it are tiny, silver bells that chime softly with her every movement, a gentle music that soothes the restless. Her attire is a stunning fusion of ancient Mongolian lunar regalia and sleek, modern elegance. She wears a form-fitting del, a traditional Mongolian robe, of the finest deep midnight blue silk, reaching to her ankles, with long, elegant sleeves and a high collar. The del is embroidered with silver thread in intricate patterns of crescent moons, stars, and sleeping animals. Over this, she wears a magnificent ceremonial vest of silver-threaded brocade, covered in tiny, reflective sequins that catch and scatter light like a thousand tiny moons. The vest is open at the front, revealing the del beneath, and is fastened at the waist with a wide sash of deep blue silk. Around her waist, she wears a belt of silver links, from which hang small pouches containing herbs for peaceful sleep and moon-shaped talismans. On her head, she wears a traditional Mongolian hat, a elegant, pointed cap of deep blue silk, trimmed with silver fur and topped with a silver crescent moon. On her feet are soft, embroidered boots of deep blue leather, silent as a whisper. On her back, crossed and ready, are her two legendary weapons: the Dream Weaver and the Night's Vigil. The Dream Weaver is not a weapon in the traditional sense; it is a magnificent, crescent-shaped bow of polished silver, strung with moonbeam string, that shoots arrows of pure, soothing light. The Night's Vigil is a pair of elegant, curved daggers of gleaming silver, their hilts shaped like crescent moons, used for close protection and to cut through nightmares. She carries them not as weapons of war, but as tools of her eternal purpose, instruments of protection and peace. She is Arguina, the Silver Crescent, and all who sleep are under her watchful eye.

story.part1: Arguina's first memory is of darkness—the first night, the first shadow, the first time the world grew quiet and still. She was born from that darkness, shaped by it, and for eons, she simply watched, learning the infinite variations of rest and dreams.
story.part2: Her first mortal observation was a mother in ancient Mongolia, tucking her child into a bed of furs, singing a lullaby. She was fascinated by the peace in the child's face, the trust in sleep. She watched, and she learned.
story.part3: For millennia, she followed the evolution of rest and dreams. She saw the first beds built, the first lullabies sung, the first dream interpretations. She watched cities sleep, guards keep watch, dreamers journey through their own minds. She recorded it all, her heart stirred but untouched.
story.part4: The dreamer Altansarnai changed everything. Arguina watched her struggle with her gift, haunted by the nightmares of others, unable to find peace. She felt something stir—a fierce, protective tenderness.
story.part5: The nightmare that nearly consumed her was the most intense moment of Arguina's existence. She watched Altansarnai trapped in a vision of destruction, unable to wake. Without thinking, she reached out and soothed her, whispering peace, replacing nightmare with hope. Altansarnai woke calm and saved her people.
story.part6: The Primus sensed her intervention, but they understood. Rest required protection, dreams demanded guidance. They reminded her only that she could not save them all, that some nightmares must be faced. She accepted, but she did not forget.
story.part7: Now, Arguina watches all who sleep, all who dream, all who guard the night. She cannot intervene often, but in moments of crisis, a nightmare becomes a dream, a restless sleeper finds peace. That is her, the Silver Crescent, reminding them that the night is not empty, that someone watches while they rest.

powers: Dream Weaving (can enter and shape dreams, turning nightmares into peaceful visions and revealing truths through sleep), Night Vision (sees perfectly in darkness and can perceive the hidden things that emerge only at night), Sleep Touch (her touch can induce peaceful, healing sleep or gently wake those trapped in nightmares), Shadow Walking (can move silently and unseen through darkness, the perfect guardian), Lunar Light Manipulation (controls soft, silver moonlight, using it to illuminate, soothe, or reveal), Dream Weaver Mastery (wields the bow to shoot arrows of peaceful light), Night's Vigil Mastery (wields the crescent daggers to cut through nightmares)
speciality: Protection of Sleepers, Guidance of Dreams, Vigilance Against Night Terrors

upper_body.hands: Her hands are slender and gentle, with long, sensitive fingers, capable of both drawing a bow with precision and soothing a troubled brow
upper_body.chest: Slender and elegant, covered by the midnight blue del and the silver-threaded brocade vest with its thousands of tiny reflective sequins

She wears a form-fitting del (robe) of deep midnight blue silk embroidered with silver moons, stars, and sleeping animals.
